text: Electronic Science and Technology is an interdisciplinary major that integrates multiple disciplines such as electronic technology, information technology, and materials science and engineering. It belongs to the Electrical category of engineering (professional code: 080702), with a four-year duration of study and confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. This major focuses on the fundamental theories and applied research in the fields of electronic devices, integrated circuits, optoelectronic technology, electromagnetic fields and microwaves, etc. It aims to promote technological innovation in industries such as communications, semiconductors, optoelectronics and artificial intelligence through the acquisition, processing, transmission and control of electronic information. It is a core supporting discipline for modern information technology and intelligent manufacturing.
